Hey everyone, I think its pretty obvious that we're trying to build a thriving community here on voat. In order to help us gear more content towards our user base, I'd love to know what drives your towards personal development. What are your goals, aspirations, and dreams? What are you working towards?

I want to be a recording guitarist. I have all the tools to start paying demos and stuff on YouTube, but I never buckle down and just do it. I've been going through a lot since I got laid off and can't find another good job because I have a misdemeanor. That shouldn't be an excuse though.I should be using it as motivation.

I myself am obsessed with skill acquisition. I devote an hour or two each day to learning something new. Currently, I am learning to program with Python and I am learning to play the guitar. Once I have a good handle on both, I intend to move onto learning Irish/Gaelic and Piano.

Other skills I've picked up over the years include cooking, reading ancient (Attic/Koine) Greek, and a little bit of wood working.

I am also attempting to lose weight. I've lost ~10 pounds this summer, and I hope to lose another 10 before September. I'm going to be learning how to fence soon and I wish to be a smaller target when my lessons begin.

My ultimate goal in life is to personify a sort of modern day renaissance man. I want to be able to do just about anything I could ever need to do in any situation, and then some. By age 40 I want to be fluent in at least 6 languages (including English, which is my native tongue) and I want to be able to competently play at least 3 different instruments.

Thankfully, I write for a living, which gives me an incredibly flexible schedule. If I had a 9 to 5 job I would never be able to do everything I do.

Weight. I really would like to gain weight. I'm so skinny. My eating habits have already improved actually due to this subverse :D   Other than that I am trying to develop my speaking skills in Spanish and knock out some PHP and Ruby hours. I know this thread was supposed to help narrow the sub down but I want to improve so much :/

Glad this sub is helping already! and TBH, I think its pretty human to be ADHD when it comes to hobbies, habits, and desires. I'm interested in learning new languages, learning new programming languages, starting 10's of businesses, working in communities like this, excelling at work, learning new "showoff" skills, cooking, making music, etc. I think in that regard, I'd like one of the focus' of this sub, to be focus on one or two things until your in the top 5 or 10% of the population in that thing. Nobody cares if your mediocre at something, they care if your great. We tend to get bored before we've truly gained a mastery, and thus all that time learning and practicing was for naught.
